verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a team chat product like Zulip, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has nothing on telemetry, analytics, usage tracking or opt-out controls. Self-hosting and export tools are adjacent features, not a documented telemetry opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
